rules.fuel: gravity (m/s^2) x 10  -> stronger gravity = more fuel
rules.food: distance from Sun in AU x 10  -> farther = more food (1 AU = 149.6 million km)
rules.minutes: time on the surface to collect information (team idea: 3, 2, 1)
rules.from_earth: closest distance from Earth in million km (Moon: 0.384 from the fact sheet; planets: their distance from the Sun minus Earth's 149.6)
